items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: In fact on one session I played tuba along with Dave Bargeron, Don Butterfield and Tony Price.

ctx.x: Yeah, right. We did, he did “The Wiz,” the movie “The Wiz,” which was huge sessions of many, many musicians. In fact on one session I played tuba along with Dave Bargeron, Don Butterfield and Tony Price. There were four tubas on this one particular session. And on another session I played bass trombone, and there were about six or eight trombones on the thing.
